description: Check whether AI assistants and answer engines can read and quote a public website: which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others) its robots.txt allows or blocks, whether it publishes llms.txt, which structured data types it declares, how its title and description read, and the search and AI checks with fixes. Shares the 24 hour cache with scan_website.

url.description: The website to check, such as example.com. Only public http and https sites.
